projects.name: NUTU
projects.description: NUTU is a personal AI assistant designed to answer questions about Mohammed Yassin's professional background. It uses Retrieval-Augmented Generation to retrieve relevant information from Yassin's professional knowledge base and generate natural AI responses. NUTU is being designed to support both text chat and voice conversations.
